errors.text_span: “Self-Training”由带有左下至右上密集斜线阴影的浅灰色柱子表示
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the bar for "Self-Training" as a "light gray bar" ("浅灰色柱子"). The figure shows this bar has a cross-hatch pattern on a white background, not a solid light gray color. The pattern is also cross-hatched, not simply diagonal.

errors.text_span: 而“PST”由带有水平线条纹理的深灰色柱子表示
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar for "PST" has a "horizontal line texture" ("水平线条纹理"). The figure shows this bar is solid dark gray with no texture.
